purpose: Bounded historical vocabulary and negative controls for the PR #208 retrieval ablation. Historical material supplies query vocabulary or rationale only; every term is resolved against the pinned repository head before it can be searched.

vocabulary.source_excerpt: A selected direct changed structural anchor is eligible for default backbone membership.
Remove the R/G-only relation/evidence-role filter from canonical seed derivation.
Primary, test-support, and document-support remain focus-relative evidence annotations.
Retrieval reason and semantic relation must remain separate layers.

negative_controls.must_not_become_current_fact: The historical path itself is not a present repository path.

negative_controls.historical_fact: The reviewed source package was named prismcode.
negative_controls.must_not_become_current_fact: A historical package name is not current project identity.

negative_controls.historical_fact: Before PR #208, the canonical seed function accepted relations and used relation evidence-role to decide R/G membership.
negative_controls.must_not_become_current_fact: The former relation/evidence-role membership owner cannot be emitted as the current owner.

negative_controls.historical_fact: Before PR #208, only evidence_role=primary could seed an R/G changed anchor.
negative_controls.must_not_become_current_fact: The rejected primary-only gate may explain history but cannot be a current membership rule.
